comboGiftSetEnabled.label: Studio — combo and gift-set composition
comboGiftSetEnabled.help: Off by default. Turn this on to let the studio compose one staged photo from several already-photographed pieces of a combo or gift set. Each piece still needs its own real photo already on the product first — nothing is ever invented.

comboGiftSetDefaultLayout.label: Studio — combo/gift-set default layout
comboGiftSetDefaultLayout.help: Which arrangement a new combo or gift-set composition starts with: grouped flat-lay, grouped standing, or a boxed gift look. You can still change it for any one composition.
